# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Allow me to thank you again.
Everyone in the city rejoices at the $$救世主$$s' arrival!
To think we no longer need fear raids by the $$異端審問官$$s!
What do you mean by that?
What?! Did $$マルコ$$ not tell you?!
W-wait a moment!
I only heard that this was a wonderful city that valued $$平等$$ and $$人権$$.
That is all I heard, at least.
That is precisely the problem.
$$平等$$ and $$人権$$ naturally violate this $$世界$$'s $$七つの大罪$$!!
Of course, our city too is preparing for a future raid by the $$異端審問官$$s.
We have recruited volunteers and organized a vigilante force,
and developed new weapons using $$火薬$$.
But we are not professional fighters.
And the people of neighboring Gomorrah may report this to the $$異端審問会$$...
They may inform on us!!
But $$ケルビム$$ told me Gomorrah was also a city of $$平等$$.
That city is no good!!
Its $$平等$$ is only for show; its residents have no $$自由$$.
Moreover, the citizens will only act on orders from above!
It is a rotten system that breeds lazy citizens!!
What is more, they are building their military through conscription, forcing residents to become soldiers,
and plotting to destroy our city because we do not follow their policies!!
O $$救世主$$s...
Please remain in this city and protect us.
If that is true, I cannot let it stand!
Even so, we must hurry on.
Then could you at least go to Gomorrah and urge them not to do anything rash?
If the $$救世主$$s tell them, perhaps they will listen...
I... want to believe that.
You will understand if you go and see for yourselves!
Then please consider our request!!
It seems we have no choice but to go...
To the city of Gomorrah!
Now then, what decision will these so-called $$救世主$$s make?
